title: Free-Look Cancellation of Fixed Indexed Annuities — Period and Refund
content:
## Contract provision: right to return (Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities)

**Refund.** The owner may return the contract for a refund of premium paid less withdrawals, without any bonus or index credit.

**Time limit.** The returned contract must be received no later than the contract delivery date plus the free-look days of the applicable period. The free-look end is found by adding the free-look days in calendar days to the contract delivery date; a contract received on that day is in time.

**Applicable period.** The tier's free-look period applies, except that when the contract replaced another annuity or life policy, the tier's replacement period replaces it; when the owner's age on the issue date was the tier's senior age or more, the tier's senior period replaces it; and when both apply the longer governs.

The facts are read from Ashgrove's record of the same contract: the contract delivery date, whether the contract was a replacement sale, and the owner's issue age.

### Free-look end on a hypothetical calendar (contract delivered 4 May 2027)

| Applicable period | Free-look end | Received 14 May | Received 15 May | Received 3 June | Received 4 June |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 days | 14 May 2027 | in time | late | late | late |
| 30 days (replacement or senior) | 3 June 2027 | in time | in time | in time | late |

The free-look end day itself is in time; the day after it is not.

### Choosing the period (figures printed for every tier: 10 days; replacement 30; senior age 60; senior 30)

| Owner's age on the issue date | Replaced another annuity or life policy | Period |
|---|---|---|
| under 60 | No | 10 days |
| under 60 | Yes | 30 days |
| 60 or more | No | 30 days |
| 60 or more | Yes | the longer of the two, 30 days |

### Refund worked through (hypothetical contract)

Premium paid 50000; premium bonus credited 3500; index credit 1200; withdrawals 2000. Refund: 50000 less 2000 is 48000; the bonus and the index credit are not refunded. On return the contract is cancelled on free look.
